questions.q: Is Oracle Fusion Cloud practice-environment access included with an LTV Academy subscription?
options: No, it must be purchased separately from a third-party provider, OracleERPGuide
No, Oracle provides it for free to all students
Yes, but only for the final capstone course
Yes, it is bundled automatically with this career path
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion Cloud access is purchased separately from OracleERPGuide (OEG); LTV Academy tuition does not include it.

questions.q: Approximately how much does an Oracle Fusion Cloud practice instance cost, and for how long?
options: It is billed per setup task completed
About $85 for three months of access
About $850 for one year of access
It is a one-time lifetime purchase
questions.explain: As last verified, OracleERPGuide's practice instance runs approximately $85 for roughly three months of access — verify current pricing before purchasing.

questions.q: Why does this course recommend activating your practice environment now rather than during the two earlier courses?
options: Earlier courses already included a different trial environment
Oracle Fusion Cloud did not exist before this course started
The earlier courses required no software access, so there was nothing yet to configure
OracleERPGuide only sells access during this specific course
questions.explain: The ERP Foundations and Accounting Fundamentals courses were designed to need no software access, so starting the access window now maximizes it against real hands-on work.

questions.q: What typically happens the very first time you sign in with a newly provisioned Oracle Fusion account?
options: You are given administrator access automatically
You must install a desktop application before continuing
You are immediately logged out and told to contact support
You are forced to set a new password meeting Oracle's complexity rules
questions.explain: First sign-in with a temporary password typically forces a password reset that meets Oracle's complexity requirements.

questions.q: What is the Navigator menu, as seen from the Oracle Fusion home page (Springboard)?
options: A report that lists every transaction posted today
The menu, usually in the top-left corner, that expands into every work area your user can reach
A setting that changes the page's color theme
A tool only administrators can see
questions.explain: The Navigator is the expandable menu, organized by application pillar, that gives access to all the work areas available to your user — including Setup and Maintenance.
